description: Read-only ownership/decision task for tools/skill-sync, .claude/skills, .agents/skills materialization and any externally owned code copied into BenchBox. Read skill-sync.conf and provenance to name each canonical repository, generated target and owner. Do not hand-edit mirrors or vendored tools. This plan grants no source writes to other repositories. Decide whether exact unchanged copies remain outside first-party scope, or whether an explicitly authorized upstream followup plus pin/sync is needed. Avoid accepting local-generated markers as permission to ignore BenchBox-owned code. Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Obtain later implementation authorization. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Freeze nonoverlapping code/test/doc paths with the integrator before dispatch. Ordinary independent PRs target develop; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Required native/external soundness review remains mandatory, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud/stress, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting, or unapproved external-repository writes.
